sentences.text: Hi everyone.
sentences.said: Hi everyone.

sentences.text: I built a system that takes a video idea, plans and generates the shots, reviews the results, and turns everything into a finished video.
sentences.said: I built a system that takes a video idea, plans and generates the shots, reviews the results, and turns everything into a finished video.

sentences.text: For this demo, I'll quickly show you the process and the final output.
sentences.said: For this demo, I'll quickly show you the process and the final output.

sentences.text: The process starts with a simple request.
sentences.said: The process starts with a simple request.

sentences.text: Instead of giving Conductor a long prompt every time, I moved the recurring instructions into the workflow.
sentences.said: Instead of giving Conductor a long prompt every time, I moved the recurring instructions into the workflow.

sentences.text: Now I can give it a short request, and the system handles the rest of the process.
sentences.said: Now I can give it a short request, and the system handles the rest of the process.

sentences.text: The first thing the system does is look at this existing video library.
sentences.said: The first thing the system does is look at this existing video library.

sentences.text: This library gives the system examples of different video styles, pacing, transitions, and storytelling.
sentences.said: This library gives the system examples of different video styles, pacing, transitions, and storytelling.

sentences.text: It uses those references as inspiration to plan a new video, rather than copying one directly.
sentences.said: It uses those references as inspiration to plan a new video, rather than copying one directly.

sentences.text: After reviewing the references, the system breaks the idea into individual shots.
sentences.said: After reviewing the references, the system breaks the idea into individual shots.

sentences.text: For this video, it created four shots with their own purpose, timing, copy, and visual direction.
sentences.said: For this video, it created four shots with their own purpose, timing, copy, and visual direction.

sentences.text: Here, I'm showing three of them: the initial brief, the campaign idea, and how that idea expands into different marketing assets.
sentences.said: Here, I'm showing three of them: the initial brief, the campaign idea, and how that idea expands into different marketing assets.

sentences.text: For this project, the system chose HyperFrames because the video needed precise text, UI, and layout instead of generative footage.
sentences.said: For this project, the system chose Hyper Frames because the video needed precise text, UI, and layout instead of generative footage.

sentences.text: For other videos, it can use models available through Fal when the shot needs things like cinematic movement or generated footage.
sentences.said: For other videos, it can use models available through Fal when the shot needs things like cinematic movement or generated footage.

sentences.text: The idea is to choose the method that best fits the shot, instead of using the same model for everything.
sentences.said: The idea is to choose the method that best fits the shot, instead of using the same model for everything.

sentences.text: Once the individual shots are ready, they're combined into the final video.
sentences.said: Once the individual shots are ready, they're combined into the final video.

sentences.text: The workflow then checks things like timing, transitions, audio, and the final output before considering the video complete.
sentences.said: The workflow then checks things like timing, transitions, audio, and the final output before considering the video complete.

sentences.text: For every finished video, the system creates its own reverse-engineering document.
sentences.said: For every finished video, the system creates its own reverse engineering document.

sentences.text: This records how the video was made, including the prompts, structure, methods used, revisions, and key learnings.
sentences.said: This records how the video was made, including the prompts, structure, methods used, revisions, and key learnings.

sentences.text: The workflow also checks that this file exists before the video can be marked complete.
sentences.said: The workflow also checks that this file exists before the video can be marked complete.

sentences.text: And this is the final video produced through that workflow.
sentences.said: And this is the final video produced through that workflow.

sentences.text: The next phase I'm working on is human realism, especially improving natural movement, hands, eye direction, and longer scenes with people.
sentences.said: The next phase I'm working on is human realism, especially improving natural movement, hands, eye direction, and longer scenes with people.

sentences.text: I'm keeping that research separate for now while I continue testing and improving it.
sentences.said: I'm keeping that research separate for now while I continue testing and improving it.
